input.frames: K consecutive video frames; use the final frame repeatedly if a final clip is short
input.spatial_transform: center-crop largest square, then resize to 224x224 using Lanczos/bicubic-quality interpolation

output.decision: average clip logits, apply softmax, then choose the larger probability

video_aggregation: For videos longer than K frames, run non-overlapping K-frame clips, average their two raw-logit vectors, then apply softmax once.
